title: eat shit & die 209
author: bpatrick
body: If an Onan can’t get Jonny Paycheck to break his silence then I don’t know what.

comments.author: randomjackass
comments.text: Not Paycheck, but glad to see some Onan!

comments.author: Winston Rowntree
comments.text: Yesss, i love these… And the coloring/shading on this one is friggin’ great, man, especially with the faces.

comments.author: Jonny Paycheck
comments.text:
LOL
I haven’t been commenting on the last few comics because I don’t want to jinx the Summer of Comics. It looks like it’s been working too. All new Curious Urgency, MSFM, and Onan with some es&d scattered in-between. I should go silent more often.
I really like whatever you did new to this one. Onan looks like he’s all business in panel 3.
